name: Magebane (Combat)
body:
Your experience fighting both against and alongside spellcasters grants you special insight into how to best defeat them.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Make a Knowledge (arcana) check when another creature within your line of sight casts a spell or activates a spell-like ability. The DC is equal to the saving throw DC of the spell or spell-like ability (even if there wouldn’t normally be a saving throw.) If this check is successful, you gain a +2 knowledge bonus to saving throws you make vs. spells or spell-like abilities cast or activated by that creature for the next minute.

Special: The knowledge bonus increases by +1 for every 5 points by which your check exceeds the DC.
